On the upper floors of {wiki:Demona}, near Carlin, there are two chests with rings. Cross the pentagram room and the corridors full of {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists} to receive a {item:Stealth Ring} and an {item:Energy Ring}.
Sorcerers like to wear a ring from time to time.
Level 60 to pass the **Gate of Expertise** in the Maze of Lost Souls, on the way to Demona (see section 1 and the {wiki:Route: Demona|route to Demona}).
or equivalent, to open the entrance hole south of Northport
or equivalent, to climb up the holes on the way out
The {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} are the biggest danger: they hit hard with magic. Bring plenty of potions.

On the way to Demona you will also meet lesser creatures, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} and {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}.
Go to the cave south of Northport
Leave **Carlin** heading north, to the cave a little **south** of Northport.
Open the hole with the shovel
Use the {item:Shovel} at this spot to dig a hole and go in.
Follow the **blue line** on the map to the next hole.
Route to the next hole (blue line)

Keep following the blue line until you find a small grove inside the cave. At the **red** spot, behind the trees, there is a hole: go down and flip the lever inside to the **right** to open the MoLS entrance. Then leave the hole.
Red spot: hole with the lever, behind the trees
If the lever is already flipped to the right, flip it to the left and then to the right again.
Follow this path to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls. You will have to cross some {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}.
Energy Fields drain your health when you cross them: go through with full health.

Inside the MoLS, follow the map step by step. In the first entrance room is the {wiki:Griffin Shield Quest|Griffin Shield Quest}. Keep going to the end of the passage and cross the level 60 **Gate of Expertise**.
Safe route inside the Maze of Lost Souls
Stay on the path: off it there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.

After the Gate of Expertise, head **north** and always follow the **right-hand** passage until you reach the stairs. {wiki:Demona|Demona} is right above: go up and continue to the main room, the **pentagram**-shaped room.

Demona is far below the {wiki:Fields of Glory|Fields of Glory}, north of Carlin, underneath the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls|Maze of Lost Souls} (MoLS). Several caves lead there; this path starts in the cave a little south of {wiki:Northport|Northport}, a small village north of Carlin (it is TibiaWiki's {wiki:Route: Demona|route to Demona}).
In the pentagram room, go to the stairway furthest **northeast**, clearing an {creature:Elf Arcanist} and a few {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} out of the way, and go down.
You reach a long corridor. Follow it to the end, to a big room full of {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists} and {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}.
This room has several Warlocks at once. Don't pull too many.
Go up **any** of the stairways in this room. Up there are more {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}.
In the **south** of this floor there are two chests (marked in purple in the image). The one on the **left** has the {item:Stealth Ring} and the one on the **right** has the {item:Energy Ring}.
The two chests (in purple) in the south of the floor
Going back through the Maze of Lost Souls

Retrace your steps to the pentagram room and go down to the MoLS. To leave the maze, follow the path on this map (there are other exits, but this is the shortest). Then leave the cave by the **same way you came in** (lever, holes and stairs) until you are back on the surface south of Northport, and return to **Carlin**.
Exit route from the Maze of Lost Souls
Use the {item:Rope} to climb up the holes you went down.
You can also leave the area by crossing Demona, following the path in this image. You will meet many of the monsters of the area, such as {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}.
Exit from the area through Demona
Alternative: teleport to the Fields of Glory

If you are comfortable hunting in Demona, go **northwest** of the pentagram room (the Star Room) and go down these stairs. Head **north** and then **west** (there are 2 {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and 2 {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}), keep going west to the end of the tunnel and then **south**. At the end of that corridor there is a teleport that takes you back to the {wiki:Fields of Glory|Fields of Glory}, north of Carlin.
Stairs northwest of the Star Room
Teleport to the Fields of Glory
